thread:
alex (PM): Quick sync — planning per-tenant opt-in canaries for the upcoming routing flags. Goal: let 1% of customers opt in per day, with SLA guardrails and automatic rollback on error budget breach.

maria (Eng): Sounds good. Main question: do we do tenant-level flags + global control, or just route slices? I'd prefer tenant flags so sales can opt customers in.

sam (Sales): yes pls. We have 3 pilot customers asking to test earlier. Need clear rollback and SLA language.

alex (PM): Pilot cohort = 3 customers, 2 regions (us-west/us-east). Launch criteria: error rate delta <= 0.5ppt, p95 latency + <50ms, token cost variance <5%.

jordan (SRE): Add: circuit-breaker threshold = 3x baseline error rate for 5m, automatic fallback to baseline model, alert to #incidents.

maria (Eng): Implementation sketch:
```yaml
feature_flag: tenant_opt_in_canary
scope: tenant
rollout_policy:
  daily_increment: 1%
  max_per_day: 1%
  regions: [us-west, us-east]
  auto_rollback:
    error_rate_multiplier: 3.0
    window: 300s
``` 
I'll submit PR to flags service.

lisa (Data): For metrics, we'll track: success_rate_by_tenant, p95_latency_by_tenant, cost_per_1k_tokens_by_tenant. I'll add a dashboard and baseline comparison.

sam (Sales): Add note: customers want a weekly opt-out window and a support runbook to revert manually.

alex (PM): Good call. Runbook + manual rollback button in console. Also need an AB test variant id so we can correlate UX.

maria (Eng): We'll expose `variant_id` header and log to traces. Also add canary sampling rate in request metadata.

deploy-bot: canary-deploy started for feature_flag=tenant_opt_in_canary, cohort=pilot-3, regions=us-west,us-east

jordan (SRE): If deploy shows any 5xx spike above threshold we'll auto-fallback. Confirmed alerts wired.

alex (PM): Next steps: Maria to PR by EOD, Lisa to dashboard by tomorrow, Sam to confirm pilot customers, Jordan to validate alerts. If everyone's :+1: we'll schedule staged enable on Monday.

maria (Eng): :+1: will do PR.

lisa (Data): :+1: dashboard ETA tomorrow noon.

sam (Sales): Confirmed with 2 customers, waiting on 3rd. Will update.

jordan (SRE): I'll run a preflight chaos test on infra and verify fallback path.

alex (PM): Thanks team — logging notes in the playbook. We'll add a little FAQ for customers.
